description: Periodic payment on a Canadian mortgage. Pass EITHER homePrice + downPayment (CMHC insurance is added under 20% down) OR loanAmount alone when the user gave the mortgage amount (e.g. "payment on a $500,000 mortgage"). Never invent a purchase price to reach a loan amount: it shifts the answer and adds a CMHC premium the user may not owe.

amortizationYears.description: Amortization in years (max 25 insured, 30 uninsured/first-time new builds)

annualInterestRatePct.description: Annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 5.25

downPayment.description: Down payment in CAD, or percent if downPaymentType='percent'. Required with homePrice.

downPaymentType.description: downPayment as dollars or percent of homePrice

homePrice.description: Purchase price in CAD, with downPayment. Omit if the user gave the mortgage amount.

loanAmount.description: Mortgage amount in CAD, instead of homePrice. No CMHC premium is added.

province.description: Province name, used only for CMHC PST on the premium

name: mortgage_payment
title: Canadian Mortgage Payment Calculator
